Prairie Cycle Club Wednesday Evening Ride

Champaign, IL · Road

Beginner friendly

Prairie Cycle Club Wednesday Evening Ride is a road group ride in Champaign, IL. Schedule: Every Wednesday evening, mid-April through Labor Day, from Start varies; see the club ride page. About 12–14 miles, 9–12 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 9–12 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Prairie Cycle Club Wednesday Evening Ride group ride

The club's easiest evening ride: 12 to 14 miles at 9–12 mph. Good for people new to riding on the road. The club also runs a Monday Mahomet ride (12–15 mph), a Tuesday morning ride, a fast Thursday evening ride (16–20 mph) and a Saturday morning ride.
